layout_spacing.surface_style: flat solid surfaces with 1px border-border, max rounded-sm, no shadows.

component_guidelines.cards: Strictly flat, 1px borders, square or max rounded-sm corners. No soft shadows. Use hover effects like -translate-y-0.5 with border darkening.
component_guidelines.timeline_stepper: Vertical layout for details pane. Use solid 2px left border. Nodes are square rather than round, colored based on status (blue for active, green for verified, red for returned/stuck).
component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp edges, zero or 2px border radius. High contrast text.
component_guidelines.tables: Zebra-less rows. Bottom border on rows only. Minimalist, dense layout. Use small text for data.
component_guidelines.badges: Square, solid color background, bold uppercase text. Example: STUCK (Red bg, White text).

animations.alert_chime: visual pulse on the stuck invoice row/badge, red border flashing slightly (animate-pulse)

login_background.description: Minimalist concrete architecture, used for a structured, serious login page background.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for text on colored backgrounds. Avoid gray-on-gray.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements must have data-testid in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Multi-role Auth System (Stores Staff, Dept Head, Dean, Finance, Admin).
Implement Invoice Table with status tracking and timeline visualization.
Use Phosphor Icons for a technical, precise look.
Charts should use Recharts (bar chart for TAT, pie/donut for stage distribution).
Stuck invoices (>3 days) MUST have a distinct red 'STUCK' badge and trigger an alert (visual pulse + browser/toast notification).
Design a detail view modal or side-panel showing the step-by-step audit trail (timeline) for an invoice.
Apply 'Swiss & High-Contrast' principles: remove gradients, use 1px hard borders, keep it flat and data-dense.
Use Chivo for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Use data-testid on every button, input, and row action.
